content.short: Hybra Finance is a decentralized exchange deployed on HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain.
content.description: Hybra Finance is a concentrated liquidity AMM on HyperEVM whose V4 release adjusts fees dynamically with volatility and volume. It uses Uniswap V4-style hooks for custom swap logic and a ve(3,3) emissions model that routes real yield to long-term liquidity providers. Earlier V2 and V3 pools remain deployed on both Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain, with V3 running unmodified Uniswap V3 contracts. V2 also supports intent-based gasless trades.
content.meta: Exchange markets deployed on both HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain as their liquidity forms.
